newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-England A take upper hand against South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-England A take upper hand against South Australia.

text.p: South Australia, needing only 170 to win in their three-day match against England, collapsed badly on Monday to be 70 for five at lunch on the final day.
Joe Scuderi was not out 13 and was sharing the crease with spinner Brad Hogg on six.
South Australia resumed on their overnight score of six without loss before Greg Blewett was dismissed without adding to his score of two.
Captain Jamie Siddons was trapped leg before wicket by Dean Headley for 18 before new batsman James Brayshaw was run out on the next ball.
Opener Ben Johnson then fell for 17 before wicketkeeper Tim Nielsen was dismissed for South Australia to be 59 for five.

South Australia are without top order batsman Darren Lehmann, who was chosen in an invitation Australian XI to play West Indies in Alice Springs on Tuesday and has already left for the Northern Territory.
